verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a scraping API aimed at AI users could plausibly offer chunked output, but the evidence never documents semantic chunking. The closest features are adjacent: `return_page_markdown` still returns a single markdown blob, and `ai_query` / `ai_extract_rules` pull out specific fields rather than splitting content into retrieval-ready chunks.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can request semantically chunked output instead of one large content blob, so it feeds cleanly into a retrieval pipeline
